title: MAP_LAND_LEVEL is dead code after the pass-1 rewrite — defined but referenced nowhere
evidence:
MAP_LAND_LEVEL   :: 0.38 // the pre-ring land threshold (kept as the reference base)
...
			lvl: f32 = MAP_INTERIOR_LEVEL + MAP_EDGE_BIAS * edge_bias_factor(x, y, w, h)
			if value_noise(seed, x, y, MAP_LAND_CELL_PX) < lvl {
detail: Its only prior use (map_generate pass 1, old map.odin:127) was replaced by MAP_INTERIOR_LEVEL + bias; repo-wide grep now finds only the definition. A future tuner changing it gets a silent no-op.
recommended_fix: Delete the MAP_LAND_LEVEL constant (keep the 0.38 history in the tuning comment) so no dead knob remains.

title: tier_pipe_width comment claims the ladder "keeps its 1:1.57:2.43 ratio" but the new values are 1:1.64:2.33
detail: 4.5:7.4:10.5 is 1:1.64:2.33; the quoted 1:1.57:2.43 is the old 3.5/5.5/8.5 ladder. The comment states a preserved invariant that the code below it breaks.
